title: Phase 0 safety inventory and execution baseline

runtimePolicy.releaseConstraint: G002 safety release is indivisible: static PII removal, auth/rules lock, service-worker cache purge, and automatic-attendance no-write kill switch must be verified together before deployment.

piiStaticSurfaces.finding: _DEFAULT_STUDENTS embeds real student names, phone numbers, ages, schedules, and memos and is merged into localStorage/Firestore.
_injectInitialInquiries initData embeds real inquiry phone numbers.
Printable evaluation/SMS templates include real owner phone and bank-account numbers; keep only if intentionally public business contact/payment data, otherwise move to private config.
Stale monolithic copy contains the same embedded student/inquiry PII and owner payment/contact numbers.
Older HTML copy contains owner contact/payment numbers and must not remain deployed/cached unintentionally.
Modular reference state embeds _DEFAULT_STUDENTS PII and SMS payment template values.
Type/reference module embeds the default student dataset with names and phones.
Reference consult module embeds inquiry phone seed data and owner payment/contact values.
Reference profile module embeds owner payment/contact values.
Reference SMS module embeds payment account/phone template values.

writeBehavior: Runs when Today schedule is built.
Uses localStorage key vsC_lastAutoFill to run once per day.
Backfills up to the previous 30 days on first run, then since lastFill.
Skips today/future dates, off-days/holidays, and dates with existing student log entries.
For each active student slot without a log, unshifts logs entry with att='출석', note='(자동)', _auto=true.
Calls saveAll() when added > 0, so localStorage and Firestore can be mutated by a render/navigation path.
automaticAttendanceMutationPath.secondaryRoutingSurface: js/ui/router.js references buildTodaySchedule(), but authoritative runtime is current index.html.
automaticAttendanceMutationPath.g002Requirement: Install a no-write kill switch so loading, refreshing, navigating, Today render, and schedule render create zero attendance/payment writes.

firebaseAndRulesSurface.runtimeAuth: index.html initFirebase() lines 3547-3559 calls firebase.auth().signInAnonymously() and starts Firestore listener even after auth failure.
firebaseAndRulesSurface.runtimeDoc: index.html _startFirestoreListener() lines 3571-3628 listens to studio/data and merges remote/local data.
firebaseAndRulesSurface.firestoreRules: firestore.rules lines 4-5 allow read, write on /studio/{docId} when request.auth != null.
firebaseAndRulesSurface.firebaseJson: firebase.json only points to firestore.rules; no hosting headers/rewrites and no storage rules config are present.
firebaseAndRulesSurface.storageRules: No storage.rules file or storage config found in the inventory; Firebase Storage URLs may exist in data but rule surface is not versioned here.
firebaseAndRulesSurface.risk: Anonymous auth plus broad authenticated read/write gives any signed-in/anonymous user access to the shared legacy data document.

dataCountsAndBackupEvidence.note: Evidence files written for G001 contain hashes/counts, not raw customer data. Existing recovery artifacts may contain private data and must remain non-public operational evidence.

g002VerificationGates.command: Use search on index.html, vocal-studio.html, vocal-studi.html, js/**/*.js, sw.js for _DEFAULT_STUDENTS, initData, known private phone/account markers, and Korean phone regex; expected result is no private student/inquiry PII in public static assets.

g002VerificationGates.check: With no authorized admin session, Firestore reads/writes to legacy or split data paths must fail under deployed rules; anonymous broad access must not succeed.

g002VerificationGates.gate: Authorized load or safe local-dev path
g002VerificationGates.check: An approved admin/session path loads current counts without dropping/rewriting data, or local-dev fails closed without destructive bootstrap.

g002VerificationGates.browserScenario: Record counts/hash, clear or spoof vsC_lastAutoFill if needed in an isolated copy, load app, navigate Today and schedule, wait for sync, confirm logs/payments/weekOvr counts and legacy document hash do not change from render-only actions.

g002VerificationGates.check: sw.js VERSION changes for safety release, activation deletes old caches, and cached stale HTML with PII is not served after reload/update.
firebase.json references Firestore and Storage rules where Storage is used; storage.rules denies unauthorized reads/writes while preserving authorized media load/upload path.
